effects: Pulls `amount` of the vault collateral (MANTA, 0x95CeF134… in 0x2261's init data) from the signer into the vault through transferFrom, using the signer's existing allowance.
Mints active vault shares for the deposited amount and credits them to `onBehalfOf`, not to the signer. The shares can be slashed.
Reverts when onBehalfOf is zero, when the signer is not whitelisted while the whitelist is on, or when the deposit limit would be exceeded.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 MANTA for the beneficiary address into the named vault, with the vault, amount and beneficiary as fields.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted to onBehalfOf comes from vault storage and is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_); _activeSharesOf[onBehalfOf].push(...). The share count depends on activeStake and activeShares in storage, which are not in the calldata.
findings.fix: None needed. The beneficiary and the asset amount already state the position.

effects: Burns enough of the signer's active shares to cover `amount` of collateral (rounded up). Reverts if the signer holds too few.
Moves `amount` of collateral into the next epoch's withdrawal pool and mints withdrawal shares for that epoch to `claimer`, who alone can claim the MANTA after the epoch ends.
Nothing leaves or arrives in the signer's wallet in this call.
formats.shown: Request a withdrawal of 2.5 MANTA for the claim owner, with the vault, amount and claim owner as fields.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of active shares burned is computed from storage and not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake()); the amount of assets is shown as 'Requested assets'.
findings.fix: None. The asset amount fixes the position change.

findings.title: withdraw: the screen does not say the funds are claimable only after the next epoch.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _withdraw: uint256 epoch = currentEpoch() + 1; withdrawalSharesOf[epoch][claimer] += mintedShares. Intent: 'Request withdrawal'.
findings.fix: An intent such as 'Request withdrawal (claimable next epoch)' would set the right expectation.

effects: Burns exactly `shares` of the signer's active vault shares. Reverts if the signer holds fewer.
Converts them at the current rate into collateral, moves that collateral into the next epoch's withdrawal pool, and mints withdrawal shares for that epoch to `claimer`.
Nothing leaves or arrives in the signer's wallet in this call. The MANTA value is decided from storage.
formats.shown: Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares for the claim owner, with the vault, the raw share count and the claim owner as fields.

findings.title: redeem: the share amount is a raw 18-digit integer that a person cannot read.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem field '#.shares' 'Vault shares (raw)' format raw; case 13 shows 987654321123456789. ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset() returns 0, so shares are on the collateral's 18-decimal scale.
findings.fix: Use format 'unit' with decimals 18 and a 'shares' unit, or a label that explains the scale, so the signer reads about 0.99 shares.

findings.title: redeem: the MANTA amount that gets queued comes from the vault's exchange rate and is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares()).

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed. Reverts if the epoch has not ended, was already claimed, or holds nothing.
Sends the signer's full withdrawal amount for that epoch, in collateral (MANTA), to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim epoch 42 to the recipient, with the vault, epoch and recipient as fields. No token or amount is shown.

findings.title: claim: the claimed MANTA amount comes from storage and is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: amount = _claim(epoch); IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount); _claim: amount = withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender).

findings.title: claim: the intent and fields never name the asset (MANTA) that goes to the recipient.
findings.evidence: descriptor claim intent 'Claim withdrawal', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'. Vault.sol claim transfers IERC20(collateral).
findings.fix: Name the token, e.g. 'Claim MANTA withdrawal' / 'Claim MANTA from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for each listed epoch as claimed. Reverts if any epoch has not ended, was already claimed, or holds nothing.
Sends the sum of those withdrawals, in collateral (MANTA), to `recipient` in one transfer.
formats.shown: Claim epochs 42, 44 and 128 to the recipient, with the vault, each epoch and the recipient as fields. No token or amount is shown.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total MANTA claimed comes from storage and is not shown.
claimBatch: the intent and fields never name the asset (MANTA) that goes to the recipient.
findings.evidence: descriptor claimBatch intent 'Claim withdrawals', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'. Vault.sol claimBatch transfers IERC20(collateral).
findings.fix: Name the token, e.g. 'Claim MANTA withdrawals' / 'Claim MANTA from epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.
